Paths are relative to the repository root.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

Load input
```{r}
dir.create("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario2/Results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
counts = read.delim("data/Gide_log2TPM.txt", row.names = 1)
load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario1/Results/deconvolution_results.RData")
```

Deconvolution given to CellTFusion

The deconvolution subgroups of Scenario 1 are reused. The Immune and Stroma features of Scenario 1 are sums of cell types that the prompt of this scenario does not ask for, so they are removed.
```{r}
is_group = function(x) grepl("^(Immune|Stroma)_|_(Immune|Stroma)$", x)

dt_cells = dt
dt_cells[["Deconvolution matrix"]] = dt[["Deconvolution matrix"]][, !is_group(colnames(dt[["Deconvolution matrix"]]))]
dt_cells[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]] = lapply(dt[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]], function(x) x[!is_group(names(x))])
dt_cells[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]] = dt_cells[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]][c(
  sapply(dt_cells[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]], length) > 0)]
dt_cells[["Deconvolution subgroups per cell types"]] = dt[["Deconvolution subgroups per cell types"]][setdiff(names(dt[["Deconvolution subgroups per cell types"]]), c("Immune", "Stroma"))]

dim(dt_cells[["Deconvolution matrix"]])
```

Transform to TPM
```{r}
counts_TPM = 2^as.matrix(counts) - 1
```

CellTFusion  
```{r}
library(CellTFusion)
res <- CellTFusion(
  raw_counts       = counts_TPM,
  dt               = dt_cells,
  normalized       = FALSE,
  file_name        = "Gide",
  return           = TRUE
)
```

Save results
```{r}
save(res, file = "evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario2/Results/CellTFusion_results.RData")
```

Clinical data

Load `data/colData_all.txt` and restrict it to the Gide cohort.
```{r}
coldata = read.table("data/colData_all.txt", header = TRUE, sep = " ", quote = "\"")
coldata_gide = coldata[coldata$Cohort == "Gide", ]
```

TME state vs immunotherapy response

Compare each latent factor score (`res$Latent_spaces$Z`) between responders and non-responders with `BioinfoTools::scores.stat.analysis.categorical()`, which runs the Wilcoxon test per factor and plots the significant ones.
```{r}
library(BioinfoTools)

scores_mat = res$Latent_spaces$Z

coldata_bio = coldata_gide[match(sub("^X", "", rownames(scores_mat)), coldata_gide$rna_id), ]
rownames(coldata_bio) = rownames(scores_mat)

dir.create("Results", showWarnings = FALSE)
sig_factors = scores.stat.analysis.categorical(
  scores  = scores_mat,
  coldata = coldata_bio,
  trait   = "Response",
  method  = "wilcox"
)
```

Summary figure

TME states across patients (score of each state as a share of the patient total, patients ordered by the first state) and the states significantly associated with response (Wilcoxon test, BH-adjusted p < 0.05).
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario2/Results/CellTFusion_results.RData")  # res
coldata = read.table("data/colData_all.txt", header = TRUE, sep = " ", quote = "\"")
coldata = coldata[coldata$Cohort == "Gide", ]

states = res$Latent_spaces$Z
response = coldata$Response[match(sub("^X", "", rownames(states)), coldata$rna_id)]

share = states / rowSums(states)
share = share[order(-share[, 1]), ]
composition = pivot_longer(data.frame(patient = factor(sub("^X", "", rownames(share)), levels = sub("^X", "", rownames(share))), share),
                           -patient, names_to = "state", values_to = "share")

a = ggplot(composition, aes(patient, share, fill = state)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 4)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of the patient's state scores", fill = NULL, title = "TME states across patients")

p = apply(states, 2, function(x) wilcox.test(x ~ response)$p.value)
tests = data.frame(state = colnames(states), p = p, fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
significant = tests$state[tests$fdr < 0.05]

significant_scores = pivot_longer(data.frame(response = factor(response, levels = c("NR", "R")), states[, significant, drop = FALSE]),
                                  -response, names_to = "state", values_to = "score")
labels = setNames(paste0(tests$state[tests$fdr < 0.05], "\nBH-adjusted p = ", signif(tests$fdr[tests$fdr < 0.05], 2)), significant)
significant_scores$state = labels[significant_scores$state]

b = ggplot(significant_scores, aes(response, score, fill = response)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~state, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("R" = "#1baf7a", "NR" = "#4a3aa7")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "State score", title = "States associated with response")

a / b + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1.5))

ggsave("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario2/Results/tme_states_summary.pdf", width = 8, height = 7)
ggsave("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario2/Results/tme_states_summary.png", width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
